reaction_NO.H_FL: high fearfulness in reaction to the novel object, flees.
reaction_NO.H_FR: high fearfulness in reaction to the novel object, freezes.
reaction_NO.L_IN: low fearfulness in reaction to the novel object, is indifferent.

attribute_information.NO_peck_nag_sec: The amount of time spent with her beak repeatedly touching the novel object, in seconds.
attribute_information.age_wk: The age of the birds at the time of testing, formatted as 15 weeks of age (woa), for example.
attribute_information.alert_stand_ag_sec: The amount of time spent upright and stationary with neck extended, in seconds.
attribute_information.alert_walk_ag_sec: The amount of time spent upright and exhibit bipedal movement with neck extended, in seconds.
attribute_information.bird_ID: The identification/tag number assigned to the test bird.
attribute_information.date: The date that the fear test was performed, formatted as DDMMYYYY.
attribute_information.diet: The type of diet fed to the test bird, either ad libitum or restricted (to 10% body weight).
attribute_information.dustbath_nag_sec: The amount of time spent stationary and on her side, raking substrate with her wings, beak, or feet, in seconds. She may roll over exhibit kicking motions.
attribute_information.emergence_time_sec: The length of time taken for the bird to emerge from a start box into the novel arena, in seconds. A maximum of 300 s is permitted without intervention. Exiting the start box is defined as box feet in the arena.
attribute_information.escape_ag_sec: The amount of time spent walking, running, or jumping at the walls of the arena, in seconds. Wing flapping may be attempted.
attribute_information.explore_nag_sec: The amount of time spent moving with head below the back and attention focussed downward, in seconds.
attribute_information.ground_peck_nag_sec: The amount of time spent with her beak repeatedly touching the floor, in seconds.
attribute_information.latency_approach_NO_sec: The length of time taken for the bird to approach the novel object, in seconds. Some birds may not approach the novel object, thus denoted by \"DNA\" - did not approach.
attribute_information.percent_ag: The percentage of time spent agitated. This is calculated as \"total_ag_sec\" divided by \"total_time_arena_sec\", then multiplied by 100.
attribute_information.percent_centre: The proportion of time (%) spent at least a body length away from the wall of the test arena.
attribute_information.percent_nag: The percentage of time spent not agitated. This is calculated as \"total_nag_sec\" divided by \"total_time_arena_sec\", then multiplied by 100.
attribute_information.percent_wall: The proportion of time (%) spent less than a body length away from the wall of the test arena.
attribute_information.preen_nag_sec: The amount of time spent stationary with beak manipulating her feathers, in seconds.
attribute_information.reaction_NO: The initial reaction to the novel object, categorized as high or low fearfulness. Bird may flee, freeze, or exhibit no noticeable change in behaviour (indifference).
attribute_information.relax_stand_nag_sec: The amount of time spent stationary and upright with both legs on the ground, in seconds.
attribute_information.room_pen: The home location of the test bird, formatted as R2P1, for example.
attribute_information.sit_nag_sec: The amount of time spent on the ground, stationary, with legs tucked under, in seconds.
attribute_information.time: The time of day that the fear test was performed, formatting using the 24 hour clock.
attribute_information.time_centre_sec: The amount of time spent in the centre of the fear test, in seconds. In the centre is defined as at least a body length away from the wall.
attribute_information.time_wall_sec: The amount of time spent around the perimeters of the fear test, in seconds. Against the wall is defined as less than a body length away.
attribute_information.total_ag_sec: The total amount of time spent exhibited agitated behaviours, in seconds. Agitated behaviour includes alert standing, alert walking, vocalization, and attempting escape.
attribute_information.total_nag_sec: The total amount of time spent exhibiting not agitated behaviours, in seconds. Not agitated behaviours includes exploring, sitting, preening, ground pecking, wall pecking, novel object pecking, relaxed standing, and dustbathing.
attribute_information.total_time_arena_sec: The total amount of time the bird spends in the novel arena, in seconds. This includes emergence from the start box to the conclusion of the test. An absolute maximum total time of 900 s may be obtained.
attribute_information.vocalization_ag_sec: The amount of time spent making audible calls, in seconds.
attribute_information.wall_peck_nag_sec: The amount of time spent with her beak repeatedly touching the wall, in seconds.

attribute_labels.NO_peck_nag_sec: Time spent pecking at the novel object (not agitated behaviour), in seconds

attribute_labels.alert_walk_ag_sec: Time spent exhibiting alert walking (agitated behaviour), in seconds

attribute_labels.ground_peck_nag_sec: Time spent pecking at the ground (not agitated behaviour), in seconds

attribute_labels.sit_nag_sec: Time spent sitting (not agitated behaviour), in seconds

meta.description: Puberty is a critical period characterized by a multitude of physiological and behavioural changes. In humans and rats, the changes in fear behaviour are well documented. In poultry, however, this topic remains largely under-researched. At 4 different developmental ages (pre-puberty, early puberty, late puberty, and post-puberty), brown-feathered layers will undergo a combined emergence/novel arena/novel object fear test to assess changes in fearfulness and threat processing throughout puberty.
meta.name: The Effect of Puberty on Fear Behaviour in Laying Pullets
